title: Name Tag Letters
description: This resource pack adds textures for letters, numbers, and symbols when renaming an name tag on an anvil.
body:
**This resource pack adds textures for letters from the Russian and English alphabets, special symbols, and numbers.** To obtain them, install the mod [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit). Support for other mods will be gradually added as mods are updated to new versions.

# How to Use
Rename an item on an anvil to the name of the desired symbol.
Names are constructed according to the following scheme:
*   For English letters: `en` + Letter, e.g., `enA` = A
*   For numbers: `nm` + Digit, e.g., `nm1` = 1
*   For Russian letters: `ru` + Letter, e.g., `ruYa` = Я

![Creating a letter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1763c2aba526d83c3c74091bd2ab04975841c00c.png)

Special symbols:
| Symbol | Name       |
|--------|------------|
| *      | symstar    |
| /      | symslash   |
| \      | symbackslash |
| (      | symobracket |
| )      | symcbracket |
| :      | symcolon   |
| ;      | symsemicolon |
| ,      | symcomma   |
| .      | symdot     |
| +      | symplus    |
| -      | symminus   |
| ≠      | symneq     |
| =      | symeq      |

Arrows: `arrow` + direction (by compass), e.g., `arrown` is an arrow pointing up, and `arrowse` is an arrow pointing down-right.

Available directions:
|*|*|*|
|---|---|---|
| ↖ nw  | n↑ | ne ↗ |
| ← w |   |  e →|
|  ↙sw | s↓  | se ↘|
